title: Drunk Girl Flirts with Cops as Her Best Friend Makes Things WAY Worse
description:
A suspected drunk driver was arrested after a traffic stop in Highlands, New Jersey took a dramatic turn. Police pulled over Karina Armando, 20, after she allegedly failed to maintain her lane on May 21, 2023. But it wouldn’t be Karina, but her “out of control” friend who interrupted police multiple times during the DUI investigation even running down the side of the road on a busy highway. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
